svg.aria-label: Where a Whip pane can live. In its project slot it sits in Whip's tab and split layout. Choose Float to keep it above every chat; drag the header to move it and the corner grip to resize it. Choose Dock to chat to attach it beside one conversation on wide windows or below it on narrow ones; Float detaches it again. Return to project restores its original slot without restarting the shell.

g.text: Return to project: original slot, same shell, no restart
